findings.title: Protect the process immediately after acquisition
findings.detail: Popen returns an owned process and pipes before buffers, Event, error list and reader list are allocated and before the protected try. A bookkeeping MemoryError escapes without process settlement or pipe cleanup.
findings.reproduction: Fake Popen succeeds; injected bytearray allocation raises the original MemoryError. Kill attempts 0, wait attempts 0, both pipe close counts 0.
findings.required_change: Preallocate bookkeeping before acquisition and establish an ownership cleanup scope immediately on successful Popen; cover partial thread startup.

findings.title: Attempt each reader cleanup and retain the primary failure
findings.detail: The final reader join and is_alive inspection are unguarded. A cleanup join fault masks the active original error and skips later readers.
findings.reproduction: Initial first-reader join raises RuntimeError; cleanup join raises MemoryError. The top-level error is cleanup MemoryError, join counts are [2,0], and pipe close counts are [1,1].
findings.required_change: Independently attempt every join and inspection, retain active primary identity, and report incomplete cleanup without claiming settlement.

findings.title: Retain ACL invocation failure during temporary-script cleanup
findings.detail: The finally unlink can replace an active invocation error with a secondary deletion failure.
findings.reproduction: Fake ACL script invocation raises RuntimeError and fake unlink raises PermissionError. PermissionError becomes the top-level error.
findings.required_change: Retain the active primary when unlink fails, while propagating cleanup failure on an otherwise successful path.

findings.title: Retain capture failure when failure-journal recording fails
findings.detail: Diagnostic log creation/write and FAILED.json recording are outside an independent recording-failure guard in invoke's exception handler. A recording error masks the original capture failure. The path still fails and does not return success, but the promised failure provenance is lost as an explicit cause.
findings.reproduction: AST-selected invoke with fake capture RuntimeError: log-open PermissionError or FAILED recording PermissionError becomes top-level with original_as_explicit_cause false. The normal recording control retains the original as the ValueError cause.
findings.required_change: Guard failure recording and preserve the original capture error as primary or explicit primary cause; do not let recording faults claim successful cleanup or qualification.
